description: Records the owner's approval of the lead journeys drafted from how the business follows up today, as Get started's follow-up step does. The journeys must already be saved as the answers draw them (answers: firstChannel, speed, followUpChannel, tries, overDays, giveUpDays; sources: the journeys approved, as lead sources such as site_thumbtack or web_form; Get started's lead sources map to them). Save the journeys first through the lead follow-up journeys setting (settings.lead_pursuit_program), drawn from these answers; otherwise the route answers journeys_not_saved. Writes no journey and sends nothing. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying. An owner-level change: Sergio tells the owner after it is made.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

reason.description: Why you are doing this, in one sentence. The owner sees it in the notice Sergio sends after the change.

name: approve_follow_up_style
title: Approve the lead journeys drafted from follow-up answers
